sections.title: 三、听力理解 (第一段对话)

audio.text: Emma: Ben, your arm is hurt. What happened? Ben: I fell while skiing yesterday. It hurt a lot. Emma: Did you see a doctor? Ben: Yes, my dad took me to the hospital. Emma: What did the doctor say? Ben: I need to take medicine three times a day and keep my arm still. Emma: So, you have to rest well and be careful next time.

questions.prompt: How did Ben hurt his arm?
options: He played basketball and hurt it.
questions.translation: 本是怎么伤了胳膊的？——滑雪时摔倒了。
questions.explanation: 对话中Ben说：'I fell while skiing yesterday.'，选A。

questions.prompt: How often should Ben take the medicine?
questions.translation: 本应该多久吃一次药？——一天三次。
questions.explanation: 对话中Ben说：'I need to take medicine three times a day.'，选B。

sections.title: 四、听力理解 (第二段对话)

audio.text: Doctor: How can I help you? Boy: I've had a stomachache from Friday. Doctor: I see. Did you have something cold or strong? Boy: I don't think so. Doctor: What kind of food do you usually eat? Boy: Fast food, and I don't usually have breakfast. Doctor: That's the problem. Eating too much fast food and skipping breakfast can cause stomachaches. You should eat healthier food and have breakfast every morning.

questions.prompt: What's wrong with the boy?
questions.translation: 这个男孩怎么了？——他胃痛。
questions.explanation: 男孩说：'I've had a stomachache from Friday.'，选A。

questions.prompt: What did the doctor ask about?
questions.translation: 医生询问了什么？——他的饮食习惯。
questions.explanation: 医生询问他通常吃什么食物（饮食习惯），选B。

questions.prompt: What is the main problem of the boy?
options: He eats fast food and doesn't have breakfast.
questions.translation: 男孩的主要问题是什么？——他吃快餐且不吃早餐。
questions.explanation: 医生指出：'Eating too much fast food and skipping breakfast can cause stomachaches.'，选C。

audio.text: Scott didn't feel well on Sunday. He was worried about his sports game on Friday. The doctor said it was a bad cold and gave him some medicine, but it didn't help quickly. Kitty gave him herbal tea from her mum and told him to drink it two times a day. Scott tried it and felt better soon, saying he wouldn't miss the game. He thought the herbal tea was like magic. The medicine together with the herbal tea made him get well soon.

questions.prompt: Scott was worried because of his music show.
questions.translation: 斯科特担心是因为他的音乐节目。
questions.explanation: 短文提到他是担心周五的运动比赛（sports game），故为F。

questions.prompt: Scott went to the doctor and knew he had a bad cold.
questions.translation: 斯科特去看医生，知道自己得了重感冒。
questions.explanation: 短文说医生诊断是重感冒（bad cold），故为T。

questions.prompt: The doctor gave Scott some medicine and he got better soon.
questions.translation: 医生给了斯科特一些药，他很快就好了。
questions.explanation: 短文提到药并没有见效很快（it didn't help quickly），故为F。

questions.prompt: Scott should drink the herbal tea four times a day.
questions.translation: 斯科特应该一天喝四次草药茶。
questions.explanation: 短文说一天喝两次（two times a day），故为F。

questions.prompt: Scott got well just because of the herbal tea.
questions.translation: 斯科特仅仅因为草药茶就好了。
questions.explanation: 短文最后提到是药物和草药茶共同作用让他康复的（The medicine together with the herbal tea...），故为F。

sections.title: 七、看图读句子
wordbank: A. The girl has got a runny nose.
B. Tom is reading without a lamp in a dark night.
C. Getting enough sleep can help people stay away from illness.
D. Reading can bring you joy.
E. Nature is good because it gives us fresh air.
F. Eating too much sweets may cause (导致) toothaches.

questions.prompt: [VISUAL: A boy sitting at a desk reading in the dark with very little light]
questions.answer: B. Tom is reading without a lamp in a dark night.
questions.translation: 汤姆在漆黑的夜晚没有开灯读书。
questions.explanation: 图片显示男孩在黑暗中看书，与选项B匹配。

questions.prompt: [VISUAL: A child crying with a swollen cheek holding a large candy lollipop]
questions.answer: F. Eating too much sweets may cause (导致) toothaches.
questions.translation: 吃太多糖果可能会导致牙痛。
questions.explanation: 图片显示孩子拿着糖果脸肿哭泣，与选项F匹配。

questions.prompt: [VISUAL: A boy sleeping soundly under a blanket in a bedroom]
questions.answer: C. Getting enough sleep can help people stay away from illness.
questions.translation: 充足的睡眠可以帮助人们远离疾病。
questions.explanation: 图片显示男孩在舒适睡觉，与选项C匹配。

questions.prompt: [VISUAL: A girl sneezing and holding a tissue to her runny nose]
questions.answer: A. The girl has got a runny nose.
questions.translation: 这个女孩流鼻涕了。
questions.explanation: 图片显示女孩拿着纸巾擦鼻涕，与选项A匹配。

questions.prompt: [VISUAL: A person taking a deep breath standing outdoors in a lush green natural park]
questions.answer: E. Nature is good because it gives us fresh air.
questions.translation: 大自然很好，因为它给我们新鲜空气。
questions.explanation: 图片显示人在户外绿树公园呼吸新鲜空气，与选项E匹配。

questions.prompt: It means little or no light.
questions.translation: 它意味着很少或没有光。
questions.explanation: dark意为“黑暗的”，与定义相符。

questions.prompt: It's an illness like a bad cold, often with a high body temperature.
questions.translation: 这是一种像重感冒一样的疾病，通常伴有高体温。
questions.explanation: flu意为“流感”，与定义相符。

questions.prompt: It is a problem or difficulty.
questions.translation: 这是一个问题或困难。
questions.explanation: matter意为“事情、问题、麻烦”，与定义相符。

questions.prompt: It is the tube(管、道) which goes from the back of your mouth down the inside of your neck.
questions.translation: 它是从你口腔后部延伸到脖子内部的管道。
questions.explanation: throat意为“咽喉、喉咙”，与定义相符。

questions.prompt: It is a very small living thing that causes infectious (传染性的) illness.
questions.translation: 这是一种引起传染性疾病的非常小的生物。
questions.explanation: virus意为“病毒”，与定义相符。

dialogue.speaker: Ryan
dialogue.text: Mike. You didn't have lunch today. [1]

dialogue.text: I ate some bread with nuts last night and then I felt sick.

dialogue.speaker: Mike

options: A. and I had a sore throat.
B. I hope you get better soon.

questions.answer: D. Did you go to the hospital?
questions.translation: 你去医院了吗？
questions.explanation: Mike回答 Yes, I did. 可知Ryan问的是是否去了医院，选项D符合。

questions.answer: C. I should take better care of myself.
questions.translation: 我应该好好照顾自己。
questions.explanation: 吸取教训，应该更好地照顾自己，选项C符合。

questions.answer: B. I hope you get better soon.

sections.title: 十、完形填空
sections.passage: My brother is not very healthy these days. Last Friday morning, he felt ill when he [1] up. He had a bad headache and a high fever, so he stayed in bed. We were very worried and took him [2] the hospital. The doctor said he had a bad cold and asked him to drink [3] water and rest for a few days. My parents thanked the doctor. Now my brother [4] much better and he can play outside. I learn that health is very [5] and we should learn to look after ourselves.

questions.prompt: when he [1] up
questions.translation: 当他起床时
questions.explanation: 文章叙述过去发生的事（Last Friday morning），用一般过去时，故选got。

questions.prompt: took him [2] the hospital
questions.translation: 带他去医院
questions.explanation: take sb. to... 是固定搭配，意为“把某人带到……”，故选to。

questions.prompt: drink [3] water
questions.translation: 喝更多的水
questions.explanation: 感冒生病时医生通常建议多喝水，故选more。

questions.prompt: Now my brother [4] much better
questions.translation: 现在我弟弟感觉好多了
questions.explanation: 标志词为 Now（现在），应用一般现在时，主语my brother是第三人称单数，故选feels。

questions.prompt: health is very [5]
questions.translation: 健康非常重要
questions.explanation: 常识及文章主旨说明健康很重要，故选important。

sections.title: 十一、连环画填空
sections.passage:
1. My name is [1]. I'm a green, funny friend. My mission(任务) is to help you make healthy choices. There are so many choices you can make every day.
2. Sometimes a [2] makes you feel happy inside. And sometimes a healthy choice might not feel quite as fun. But don't let that stop you, just make a new one.
3. You can [3] what you eat. Eat colourful, fresh and yummy food like fruits and vegetables. They are good for your body and help you stay healthy.
4. You can choose how you play. Your body is made to move, climb, run or even turn upside down. [4] your body keeps you strong and healthy.
5. You [5] need to make safe choices. Wear your helmet when you ride, wear your seat belt in the car, and put on sunscreen when you go outside on hot days.
6. So when you are not sure what to choose, just stop and think, "What would Choosy say?" Then make healthy choices and take good care [6] yourself.

questions.prompt: My name is [1].
questions.translation: 我的名字叫乔西。
questions.explanation: 根据短文主人公名字，填Choosy（原卷标号E）。

questions.prompt: Sometimes a [2] makes you feel happy inside.
questions.translation: 有时一个选择会让你内心感到快乐。
questions.explanation: 根据句子结构与名词词义，填choice。

questions.prompt: You can [3] what you eat.
questions.translation: 你可以选择你吃什么。
questions.explanation: 情态动词can后接动词原形choose。

questions.prompt: [4] your body keeps you strong and healthy.
questions.translation: 活动你的身体能让你保持强壮和健康。
questions.explanation: 动名词短语作主语，首字母大写，填Moving。

questions.prompt: You [5] need to make safe choices.
questions.translation: 你也需要做出安全的抉择。
questions.explanation: 表示“也”，填also。

questions.prompt: take good care [6] yourself.
questions.translation: 照顾好你自己。
questions.explanation: take good care of 是固定短语，填of。

sections.title: 十二、阅读海报判断正误
sections.passage:
Monday, April 6th: Grandma is not feeling well today. She has a high fever and a bad cough. She doesn't want to eat anything. Dad says we may need to see a doctor. I'm worried, so I stay by Grandma's side.
Tuesday, April 7th: Today, Dad drives Grandma to see the doctor. The doctor checks her carefully and says she has the flu. He tells Grandma to take the medicine on time, drink more warm water, and get plenty of rest. I hope she will get better soon.
Saturday, April 11th: Grandma is getting better, but she looks bored staying in bed all day. So Mum cooks a light meal, and I draw her a picture. Seeing this, Grandma smiles happily and sticks it on the wall.
Tuesday, April 14th: Great news! Grandma is well again. She can walk around the house. We all feel happy and proud. I learn that love and care can help people get well. We will help Grandma exercise and eat healthy food every day.

questions.prompt: Grandma has a fever and cough on Monday.
questions.translation: 奶奶在周一发烧并咳嗽。
questions.explanation: 对应日记第一篇：'She has a high fever and a bad cough.'，故为T。

questions.prompt: The doctor asks Grandma to drink some milk.
questions.translation: 医生让奶奶喝一些牛奶。
questions.explanation: 日记中医生建议喝温水（drink more warm water），故为F。

questions.prompt: Grandma feels bored because she cannot go outside.
questions.translation: 奶奶感到无聊因为她不能外出。
questions.explanation: 对应日记第三篇：'Grandma is getting better, but she looks bored staying in bed all day.'，故为T。

questions.prompt: The child draws a picture for decoration(装饰).
questions.translation: 孩子画画是为了装饰。
questions.explanation: 孩子画画是为了解闷让奶奶开心（she looks bored... and I draw her a picture），故为F。

questions.prompt: The story shows that love and care are important.
questions.translation: 这个故事表明爱与关怀很重要。
questions.explanation: 对应日记第四篇：'I learn that love and care can help people get well.'，故为T。

sections.title: 十三、阅读理解 A
sections.passage:
Hello, everyone. I am the Norovirus. I am very small, so you cannot see me with your eyes.
I can move from one person to another and make people feel sick. I can make more viruses and grow quickly inside the body. When people cough or sneeze, I can travel to others easily. I can also stay on hands and in the air for a short time.
If someone gets sick, they may have a fever, a cough, or feel very tired. Some people may have a sore throat or trouble breathing.
So, what should you do? Stay away from crowded places, where people are close to each other, like busy shops or markets. Wash your hands often and wear a mask when you go out.
Be careful, and you can stay safe and healthy!

questions.prompt: How can the virus spread(传播)?
questions.translation: 病毒是如何传播的？——通过咳嗽或打喷嚏。
questions.explanation: 根据短文 'When people cough or sneeze, I can travel to others easily.'，选A。

questions.prompt: Where can the virus stay for a short time?
options: On hands and in the air.
questions.translation: 病毒可以在哪里停留短时间？——在手上和空气中。
questions.explanation: 根据短文 'I can also stay on hands and in the air for a short time.'，选A。

questions.prompt: What's the meaning of the underline word crowded?
questions.translation: 划线单词crowded的意思是什么？——拥挤的。
questions.explanation: 根据上下文 'where people are close to each other, like busy shops or markets' 可知意为拥挤的，选B。

questions.prompt: What can we learn about the virus from the passage?
options: It only lives in cold places.
It can spread easily between people.
It grows slowly inside the body.
questions.translation: 我们从文章中能了解到关于病毒的什么？——它很容易在人与人之间传播。
questions.explanation: 根据短文描述其传播快、人传人，选B。

questions.prompt: What's the main purpose of this passage?
options: To make people afraid of the viruses.
To talk about how viruses grow in the body.
To talk about viruses and how to stay away from them.
questions.translation: 这篇文章的主要目的是什么？——谈论病毒以及如何远离它们。
questions.explanation: 文章既介绍了诺如病毒的特点又给出了预防建议，选C。

sections.title: 十四、阅读理解 B
sections.passage:
Do you know "jumping bean" and "couch potato"? They show two different habits in our daily life.
A "jumping bean" is a person who is very active. This person likes to move, play sports, and try new things. After school, a jumping bean may run, jump, or play with friends.
A "couch potato" is very different. This person sits for a long time, watching TV or using a phone or computer. He or she does not get enough exercise. These habits can affect (影响) our health. Being active helps our bodies stay strong and healthy. Sitting too long is not good for us.
So how can we change from a "couch potato" into a "jumping bean"? First, don't spend too much time on screens (屏幕). Second, try to move every day, such as walking or playing sports. At last, go outside more and have fun with your friends. This can also make you feel happy. Every small change can help you stay healthy and strong.

questions.prompt: What does a "jumping bean" like to do?
questions.translation: “跳豆”喜欢做什么？——运动和做体育活动。
questions.explanation: 根据短文 'This person likes to move, play sports...'，选B。

questions.prompt: What can we learn about "couch potatoes"?
questions.translation: 我们能了解到关于“沙发土豆”的什么？——他们可能有不健康的习惯。
questions.explanation: 根据短文描述“沙发土豆”坐很长时间缺乏锻炼，属于不健康习惯，选B。

questions.prompt: According to the passage, what helps our bodies stay strong and healthy?
questions.translation: 根据文章，什么有助于我们的身体保持强壮和健康？——每天做运动。
questions.explanation: 根据短文 'Being active helps our bodies stay strong and healthy.'，选A。

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.translation: 这篇文章主要讲的是什么？——健康与不健康的生活方式。
questions.explanation: 全文对比了“跳豆”和“沙发土豆”两种生活方式，选A。

questions.translation: 如果我想成为一个“跳豆”，我会每天尝试运动。
questions.explanation: 根据文中提到的改变方法，可以回答：try to move every day / not spend too much time on screens / go outside more and have fun with my friends等合理内容。
